description: Google Workspace admin directory: users, groups, and organizational units.

auth.label: Google Workspace admin
auth.setup_notes: Sign in with an account holding Google Workspace super admin rights. Creating users also requires the Admin SDK Directory API to be enabled in the linked Google Cloud project.

capabilities.description: Creates a Google Workspace user account and mailbox.

primary_email.description: The full email address for the new account, including the domain. Usually built upstream from the person's name and the company domain.

password.description: Initial password. Route this through a sensitive workflow variable rather than writing a literal, because a literal here is a secret committed into a stored blueprint.

change_password_at_next_login.description: Force a password change on first sign-in. Leave on for any account created by automation.

org_unit_path.description: Which organizational unit the account belongs to.

rate_limit.notes: Admin SDK Directory quota is per project and shared across every workflow using the same credential.
